Quick, easy: Moules Marinieres (Mariner's Style Mussels)
2 Tbsp butter
a Leek, sliced finely (white part only, very well rinsed)
a Shallot, sliced finely
5 Garlic cloves (or less if you are not a garlic fan)
2 Bay leaves
2 cups white wine
2 lbs Mussels
1 Tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp lemon zest
3 Tbsp parsley, minced

Lightly sautee the leek, shallot, garlic & bay leaves in half of the butter in large pot. Turn up the heat so as to bring it to a boil & add the wine. Toss mussels in & cover. Shake pan occasionally until the mussels open. Remove mussels & set aside. Discard any mussels that did not open. They are no bueno. Quickly whisk in the other half of the butter, lemon juice+zest and parsley. Add the mussels back in and serve immediately with a nice crusty baguette to soak up all the yummy juices.
About 10-15 minutes start to finish, and delicious.
